alkylation reagent: the gel cubes were alkylated in 50 mM iodoacetamide/50 mM ABC for 45 min at room temperature in the dark
alkylation concentration: the gel cubes were alkylated in 50 mM iodoacetamide/50 mM ABC for 45 min at room temperature in the dark
cleavage agent: covered with trypsin solution (Promega, 6.25 ng/ml in 50 mM ABC)
collision energy: the HCD (higher-energy collision) cell (1.6 amu isolation width, 25% normalized collision energy)
fractionation method: in-depth proteomics based on label-free nanoLC-MS/MS of gel-fractionated proteins to generate proteomic profiles of a cohort of 20 patients
fragmentation method: the top 10 peptide signals (charge-states 2+ and higher) were submitted to MS/MS in the HCD (higher-energy collision) cell
instrument: Eluting peptides were ionized at a potential of +2 kVa into a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher, Bremen, Germany)
labeling: in-depth proteomics based on label-free nanoLC-MS/MS of gel-fractionated proteins to generate proteomic profiles of a cohort of 20 patients
reduction reagent: the gel cubes were reduced in 10 mM DTT/50 mM ABC at 56 °C for 1 h
reduction concentration: the gel cubes were reduced in 10 mM DTT/50 mM ABC at 56 °C for 1 h
